_meta.description: Prerequisite concept graph for Middle School Mathematics (Common Core 6-8) aligned with ASSISTments / FoundationalASSIST dataset.

nodes.name: Arithmetic & Operations
nodes.description: Elementary and foundational operations with fractions, decimals, and whole numbers (OA, NBT, NF, MD).

nodes.name: The Number System
nodes.description: Rational and irrational numbers, negative integers, dividing fractions, and number line reasoning (6-8.NS).

nodes.name: Ratios & Proportions
nodes.description: Ratio concepts, unit rates, percentages, and proportional relationship modeling (6-7.RP).

nodes.name: Expressions & Equations
nodes.description: Writing and evaluating algebraic expressions, solving one- and two-step linear equations and inequalities (6-8.EE).

nodes.name: Functions
nodes.description: Understanding function definitions, input-output mapping, and linear models (8.F).

nodes.name: Geometry
nodes.description: Area, surface area, volume, scale drawings, circles, angle relationships, and the Pythagorean theorem (6-8.G).

nodes.name: Statistics & Probability
nodes.description: Statistical variability, distributions, random sampling, and probability models (6-8.SP).

edges.justification: Arithmetic operations are necessary for extending the number system to negative and rational numbers.
Multiplication, division, and fractions are foundational to calculating rates and ratios.
Rational number operations directly underpin unit rates and proportional comparisons.
Evaluating algebraic expressions requires operations on real and signed numbers.
Proportional reasoning (y = kx) forms the conceptual bridge to linear algebraic equations.
Functions formalize input-output relations from algebraic equations.
Geometric formulas (area, volume, angle sums) require solving algebraic equations.
Linear functions connect directly to coordinate geometry and slope.
Calculating statistical measures of center and spread requires signed number arithmetic.
Probability values are defined as ratios and proportions between 0 and 1.
